DORSET DIVISION / LEGAL

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 25 October 2026

Who is responsible

Marnie Danson trading as Dorset Division is the controller of personal information collected for website enquiries, direct client administration and review moderation. Contact marnie@dorsetdivision.co.uk or 07342 729185. The postal correspondence address is in Legal Information. This notice covers this website and direct dealings with Dorset Division.

Website enquiries and correspondence

The enquiry form collects your name, email, optional business name, project type and message. Cloudflare processes the request and Resend delivers it to the Dorset Division Gmail inbox. Your email is supplied as the reply address. I use these details to respond and take steps towards a requested contract, or for the legitimate interest of handling general enquiries. If direct sending is unavailable, the form may instead prepare an email in your own email app; you still need to send it. Telephone and direct email correspondence are used for the same purposes.

Client projects and records

Project administration may involve contact details, briefs, supplied files, correspondence, quotes, agreements, invoices and payment records. I use these to perform a contract, comply with accounting and legal duties, and protect the legitimate interests of running the business and resolving disputes. If I process personal data on a client’s instructions, the client’s controller responsibilities and our agreed processing terms also apply.

Reviews and publication

Submitting a review sends your name, email, optional business or project, rating and review to Cloudflare. It is stored in a Cloudflare D1 database for moderation. Your email is not included in the public review feed. Approved reviews may display your name, optional business or project, rating, text and date. Unapproved reviews are not intentionally published. I use the submission to moderate and manage feedback and maintain a trustworthy account of client experience. Publication is based on the legitimate interest of sharing authentic feedback in the context explained when you submit. You can contact me to request correction, removal or to object. Moderation does not guarantee that every review will be published.

Burt, the digital assistant

When you send a message to Burt, the message, current page path and recent conversation context are sent through Cloudflare to Workers AI to generate a reply. The website keeps the current conversation in page memory rather than saving a persistent chat history in your browser. Closing or reloading a page does not erase any operational logs retained by a service provider. I use this service for the legitimate interest of answering visitor questions. Burt is automated, can make mistakes and does not make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects, agree contracts, take payments or replace personal advice. Do not share passwords, payment information, health details or other sensitive information. You can contact me directly instead.

Bookings, external links and fonts

Call-booking links take you to Cal.com, where the booking information you provide is handled under its privacy information and used to arrange the call you request. PeoplePerHour links and the optional profile widget connect to PeoplePerHour. The website also requests fonts from Google Fonts, which can expose technical request information such as your IP address to Google. External providers control their own sites and notices; they do not receive permission to use your information for unrelated purposes merely because you contacted Dorset Division.

Technical information and cookies

Cloudflare processes network information, including IP addresses and request details, to deliver and protect the site. The enquiry and review endpoints use an IP-based rate limiter to reduce abuse. The contact endpoint logs provider acceptance identifiers and statuses rather than the enquiry text or API key. Browser storage remembers your cookie choice. See the Cookie Policy for storage and optional content.

Providers and overseas processing

Providers used for these website functions include Cloudflare, Resend, Google/Gmail, Cal.com and PeoplePerHour. Professional advisers, accounting or payment providers may receive information where necessary for an agreed project, legal duty or dispute. I do not sell personal information. Providers may process information outside the UK. Where I make a restricted international transfer, it must be covered by a lawful mechanism such as applicable UK adequacy regulations or appropriate contractual safeguards. Contact me for information about safeguards relevant to your data; this notice does not imply that selecting a European sending region keeps all processing in the UK.

Provider information: Cloudflare, Resend, Google, Cal.com and PeoplePerHour.

How long information is kept

Retention depends on the purpose rather than an indefinite default. Enquiry correspondence is kept while the enquiry, related work or a reasonably anticipated follow-up is active. Client records are retained for delivery, outstanding obligations and relevant accounting, legal or dispute requirements. Self-employment tax records must normally be kept for at least five years after the 31 January submission deadline for the relevant tax year, or longer where HMRC rules require. Review records are retained while needed for moderation, publication, authenticity queries or complaints; removal requests are considered individually. The consent choice remains in local browser storage until it is replaced or cleared. Provider logs and backups have their own retention arrangements. Information no longer needed for these purposes is to be deleted or anonymised; you can ask about the criteria applying to a particular record.

Your choices and rights

You can ask to access or correct your personal information and, where applicable, request erasure, restriction or portability, object to processing based on legitimate interests, or withdraw consent for a consent-based use. Email marnie@dorsetdivision.co.uk. I may need proportionate information to verify identity. Requests are normally answered within one month; if a lawful extension or exception applies, I will explain it. Providing enquiry details is necessary to respond through the form, but you can contact me another way. I do not add enquirers or reviewers to a marketing list automatically.

Concerns and updates

Please contact me first if you have a concern. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office. This notice may be updated as services change; the date above identifies this version. Changes to an existing project agreement require separate agreement where applicable.
